tools.name: geocode
tools.description: Look up an address, place name or point of interest and get coordinates (lat, lon), a readable label and address parts, from OpenStreetMap data. Use it before static_map or privacy_area_map when you only have an address. Counts 1 address lookup against the account's monthly cap. Results may be store

tools.name: reverse_geocode
tools.description: Find the nearest address or place to a latitude/longitude, from OpenStreetMap data. Counts 1 address lookup against the account's monthly cap. Same storage terms and attribution as geocode.

tools.name: static_map
tools.description: Render a map as an image (returned inline) with optional pins (markers) and a line (path, e.g. a route). Give center and zoom, or just markers and/or path and the view is fitted automatically. Also returns a reusable image URL for web pages (add your key). Counts 1 static image against the account's

tools.name: privacy_area_map
tools.description: Show roughly where a place is without revealing the exact point.
